title: botai learning profile
description: A learner's learning-style profile: preferences and measured parameters, not a diagnosis. Every score is a hint for choosing how to present material, never a claim about ability and never a grading input. `dominant_style` is stored rather than recomputed so consumers read one consistent value; it is derived from the four style scores at update time. The profile is recomputed every 5 sessions — `interaction_count` and `sessions_since_update` exist so a consumer can tell a profile built from many interactions from a fresh one.

student_id.description: UUID, not slug: the learner id is the same identity key used by `learner_id` in the progress and session records, and a UUID is not guessable from a display name — the profile travels with the learner, not with a username.

cognitive_style.description: Four preference scores, each independently 0..1. They are preferences, not measured skill: a high visual score says how this learner likes material presented, not how well they read diagrams.

measured_wpm.description: Measured reading speed in words per minute. Bounded 50..500: outside that band the number is a measurement error, not a learner.

avg_time_per_concept.description: Average seconds spent per concept. Floor of 60 seconds: a faster average means the concept was skipped, not learned.

pace.description: How fast this learner moves. Measured values, not targets — the harness paces to the learner, never to an expected number.

depth_preference.description: How much depth the learner asks for: surface = definitions, strategic = enough to pass, deep = derivations and edge cases.

challenge_tolerance.description: How much difficulty the learner welcomes before disengaging. 0 = wants scaffolding, 1 = wants to be pushed.

feedback_style.description: How feedback is delivered. Socratic-first is the policy default; `socratic_then_direct` escalates to direct only after the learner asks or stalls.

dominant_style.description: The derived dominant style, stored so consumers need not recompute it. Derived at update time from the four cognitive_style scores; omitted until the first recompute.

interaction_count.description: How many interactions the profile was built from. A profile from 2 interactions is a guess; this field says so.

sessions_since_update.description: Sessions since the profile was last recomputed. The design recomputes every 5 sessions; a value above 5 means the recompute is overdue.
